summary: Integra Resources Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the appointment of three seasoned mining executives: Scott Trebilcock as Senior VP of Corporate Development, Whitney Buhlin as VP of Human Resources, and Josh Serfass as VP of Business Development and Investor Relations. The appointments are effective May 25, 2026. The filing does not involve any financial terms, transaction structure, or board recommendation regarding a merger, acquisition, or other special situation. It is a routine management addition, not an abrupt departure or forced change.
